answer: Unique-SIM binding: an agent unlocks rewards only after a live SMS challenge to a number no other identity has claimed. The challenge is fired through a short random inlet each epoch, so one handset cannot be cycled across shells on a schedule. An honest agent binds a single personal line. A sybil farm must buy, KYC, and keep alive a separate SIM per fake; activation fees and idle prepaid stock make the bill spiral with every extra identity, and burned numbers become as unsellable as stained sable.
